name: Full 360 -- one object per direction
description: Four identical poles 6 m from the sensor, one in each cardinal direction: FRONT (+X), REAR (-X), LEFT (+Y), RIGHT (-Y). Used to verify the coordinate convention (+X front, +Y left, -X rear, -Y right) end to end and that each directional clearance sector reflects the correct pole. All obstacles are far and stationary, so overall risk is SAFE.
